title: 日 sun (日字旁)
intro: 日 means sun or day. On the left it is tall and narrow (明, 晚); on top or bottom it is short and wide (星, 春). Characters with 日 are about time, light, weather and seasons.

ex.p: nǐ míng bai wǒ de yì si ma
ex.en: Do you understand what I mean?

ex.zh: 明天是晴天，我们去爬山吧。
ex.p: míng tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù pá shān ba
ex.en: Tomorrow will be sunny, let's go hiking.

ex.zh: 他很聪明，学什么都很快。
ex.p: tā hěn cōng ming xué shén me dōu hěn kuài
ex.en: He's clever, he learns everything fast.

ex.p: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
ex.en: I get up at seven every morning.

ex.p: zǎo chén de kōng qì hěn hǎo
ex.en: The early-morning air is fresh.

ex.p: nǐ chī zǎo fàn le ma
ex.en: Have you had breakfast?

ex.zh: 昨天晚上我十一点才睡觉。
ex.p: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ shí yī diǎn cái shuì jiào
ex.en: Last night I didn't go to bed until eleven.

ex.p: wǎn ān
ex.en: Good night!

ex.p: duì bù qǐ wǒ lái wǎn le
ex.en: Sorry, I'm late.

ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān
ex.en: I don't have time.

ex.p: zuò fēi jī yào sān gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: The flight takes three hours.

ex.zh: 昨天晚上我十一点才睡觉。
ex.p: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ shí yī diǎn cái shuì jiào
ex.en: Last night I didn't go to bed until eleven.

ex.p: nǐ zuó tiān jǐ diǎn shuì jiào
ex.en: What time did you go to bed yesterday?

ex.zh: 明天是晴天，我们去爬山吧。
ex.p: míng tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù pá shān ba
ex.en: Tomorrow will be sunny, let's go hiking.

ex.zh: 最近天气越来越暖和了。
ex.p: zuì jìn tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo le
ex.en: The weather is getting warmer lately.

ex.zh: 春节是一个温暖的节日。
ex.p: chūn jié shì yī gè wēn nuǎn de jié rì
ex.en: Spring Festival is a warm holiday.

ex.p: chūn tiān lái le
ex.en: Spring has come.

ex.zh: 春节是一个温暖的节日。
ex.p: chūn jié shì yī gè wēn nuǎn de jié rì
ex.en: Spring Festival is a warm holiday.

ex.p: wǒ yī gè xīng qī shàng wǔ tiān bān
ex.en: I work five days a week.

ex.p: jīn tiān xīng qī jǐ
ex.en: What day of the week is it today?

ex.p: wǎn shang de xīng xing hěn liàng
ex.en: The stars are bright at night.

ex.p: zǎo chén de kōng qì hěn hǎo
ex.en: The early-morning air is fresh.

ex.p: zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng tài měi le
ex.en: The scenery here is beautiful.

ex.p: fáng jiān lǐ tài àn le kāi dēng ba
ex.en: It's too dark in the room, turn on the light.

texts.title: 读一读 · 日 sun (日字旁)

lines.zh: 春天来了，天气越来越暖和。
lines.p: chūn tiān lái le tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo

lines.zh: 昨天是星期天，也是一个晴天。
lines.p: zuó tiān shì xīng qī tiān yě shì yī gè qíng tiān

lines.zh: 早晨六点，我和爸爸去山上看日出。
lines.p: zǎo chén liù diǎn wǒ hé bà ba qù shān shàng kàn rì chū
shān shàng de fēng jǐng hěn měi

lines.zh: 晚上，我们在外面看星星。
lines.p: wǎn shang wǒ men zài wài miàn kàn xīng xing

lines.zh: 爸爸说：“明天你还要上学，早点儿睡吧。”
lines.p: bà ba shuō míng tiān nǐ hái yào shàng xué zǎo diǎn ér shuì ba

qs.q: 爸爸为什么让“我”早点儿睡？

exercises.why: 朋 is two moons; bright is sun + moon

exercises.q: 作天晚上我十一点才睡觉。
exercises.ans: 昨天晚上我十一点才睡觉。
exercises.why: 作 has 亻; days have 日
生 is only the sound part
京 is only the sound part
音 is only the sound part
